text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The day to avenge our defeat has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Days spent reflecting on my inexperience from the last race
and piling on effort after effort—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Without fail, I will take first place...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Just sit back, relax, and watch me race!
